description: Datepicker by Solverix is a Power BI custom visual designed to provide advanced and flexible date filtering beyond the default Power BI slicer. The visual enables report creators and consumers to filter data using preset date ranges, custom ranges, and ISO-compliant calendar logic, improving usability and analytical workflows across time-based reports. Key features include: • Preset date ranges such as Today, Yesterday, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, Month-to-Date, and Year-to-Date • Custom date range selection • ISO-8601 compliant week handling • Support for Date and DateTime fields • Clean and responsive user interface optimized for report resizing • Seamless integration with Power BI filtering behavior Datepicker by Solverix runs entirely inside Power BI and does not require external services, authentication, or network requests. All data remains within the Power BI report environment. This visual is ideal for financial reporting, operational dashboards, and professional analytics use cases where precise and user-friendly date filtering is required.
